services.desc: Schedule our space for your corporate gathering, non-profit gala, fundraiser, training forum, album release party, and much more! Aurora Borealis offers multiple venue rental options based on the size of your group and the level of attention associated with your private event. Full-service catering from our kitchen offering American fare from morning to late night (breakfast, lunch, dinner, appetizers) and banquet to family style meals. Bar plans can include simple beer and wine to full-bar offerings, choose to host all drinks, some through drink tickets, or allow guests to purchase.
